summary: The agent provides a comprehensive pipeline with good feature engineering and carefully implemented out-of-fold target encoding. However, it suffers from data leakage by fitting TF-IDF/SVD and computing group aggregations on the combined train/test dataset. Additionally, it ignores the temporal nature of the building permits data by using a random K-Fold split instead of a time-based validation strategy.
